subject: Add SCP/SFTP file browser with dual-pane transfer interface
body:
Add SCP/SFTP file browser with dual-pane transfer interface

Implements comprehensive SCP/SFTP file transfer functionality with a modern dual-pane file browser interface.

Features:
- New SCP protocol (ProtocolSCP_DotNet) using SSH.NET library
- Dual-pane file browser (local and remote) with directory tree navigation
- Bidirectional file transfer (upload/download)
- Delete files/folders (local and remote)
- Visual feedback with icons for files, folders, and mount points
- Mount point detection for Linux/Unix systems (/proc/mounts)
- Status bars showing selection info and transfer progress
- Escape key to clear all selections from both panels
- Multi-layered keyboard event handling for reliability

UI Components:
- ScpFileTransferControl: Main control with dual-pane layout
- LocalFileBrowserPanel: Local file system browser
- RemoteFileBrowserPanel: SFTP remote file browser
- FileListItem: Model for file/folder representation

Technical Details:
- Uses ObjectListView for enhanced file lists
- Icon support using mRemoteNG image resources
- BeginUpdate/EndUpdate for flicker-free UI updates
- ProcessCmdKey override for reliable keyboard handling
- Event-driven architecture with loose coupling

Integration:
- Added SCP protocol to ProtocolFactory and ProtocolType enum
- Updated connection serialization to support SCP properties
- Added localization strings for SCP protocol
